interestRows.studentInterest: becoming an academically trained primary-school teacher
interestRows.finding: Exact PWPO identity includes academic teacher formation; no UCR teaching qualification is implied. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: how young children learn and develop
interestRows.finding: Child development is defining and supported by UCR lifespan development, with limits of lifespan breadth. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: improving primary education through scientific research
interestRows.finding: Research and classroom practice are integrated; general methods do not certify educational intervention enquiry. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: child-rearing and pedagogy in primary schools
interestRows.finding: Pedagogy and classroom relationships are central; broad psychology is a genuine partial contribution. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: designing effective lessons for primary-school children
interestRows.finding: Lesson design is assessed in sequenced stages; UCR rhetoric teaching supports one limited instructional area. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: classroom management and supportive learning environments
interestRows.finding: Classroom management5EC and ongoing stages are required; social psychology is not equivalent. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Evidence-based teaching integrates theory and supervised practice; not generic knowledge of research. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Nine5EC subject-didactic units are required across three years, concurrent with stages. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: supervised teaching practice in primary classrooms
interestRows.finding: Four required placements33EC with stage-to-stage progression; UCR rhetoric project is distinct. No retained UCR programme ownership.
EDI is explicit in first-year stage content and official programme pages; not inferred from generic communication. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Technical reading5EC is required; psycholinguistics is foundational but not reading instruction. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Spelling5EC and writing/speaking5EC are required; stylistics/rhetoric are distinct. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Numeracy/mathematics didactics5EC is required; general data statistics is not teaching children maths. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Handwriting didactics5EC is required; no UCR instructional substitute found. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Text comprehension/literature didactics5EC is required; psycholinguistics/style contribute partial foundations. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Children’s literature is taught within subject didactics, not merely university literary study. No retained UCR programme ownership.
History teaching falls within world-orientation didactics5EC; university history content is not pedagogy. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Geography teaching is within world orientation, not a separate guaranteed geography course. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: science and technology education for children
interestRows.finding: Science/technology teaching is within world orientation, not university science alone. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: art and culture education in primary schools
interestRows.finding: Art/culture didactics5EC is required, concurrent with stage; art content alone is not didactics. No retained UCR programme ownership.
English teaching is part of multilingual didactics; oralEnglish is assessed underOER9.2. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Multilingual didactics5EC is required; UCR psycholinguistics genuinely supports language understanding. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: learning difficulties and additional educational needs
interestRows.finding: LearningProblems4EC and orthopedagogical foundations are required; no clinical competence promised by UCR. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: mental-health and behavioural difficulties in children
interestRows.finding: Child/youth psychopathology4EC is required; UCR abnormal psychology has broader lifespan scope. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Official programme discusses typical/atypical motor development; not an extra credited unit. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: how the brain supports children’s learning
interestRows.finding: Learning/brain knowledge is curricular context; UCR cognition is relevant without instructional equivalent. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Psychometrics4EC and analysis sequence are required; UCR statistics is meaningful but not complete psychometrics training. No retained UCR programme ownership.
EducationalQuality3EC is required; broad sociology/politics do not establish school-quality methods. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: the philosophy of education and scientific knowledge
interestRows.finding: PhilosophyOfScience4EC is required; political philosophy is a different emphasis. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: school identity and the social role of education
interestRows.finding: SchoolAndSociety3EC is required; sociology supports broad context only. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: children’s autonomy and rules in the classroom
interestRows.finding: Illustrative autonomy/rules question is search-only, not a compulsory standalone topic or UCR generator. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Illustrative pupil-privacy question is search-only; actual confidentiality is integral to stages/thesis. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestRows.studentInterest: ethical and legal questions in primary education
interestRows.finding: LegalEthicalContext4EC is required; general human rights is partial, not specific education law. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Stage3 focuses on kindergarten/lower school; no UCR primary-school ages9–12 equivalence. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Stage2 and graduation stage address older pupils/whole-day teaching; rhetoric lesson project has narrower scope. No retained UCR programme ownership.
